title: Direct RNA Sequencing Using Oxford Nanopore Technologies
author: Anita Adami
materials: NEBNext High Input Poly(A) mRNA Isolation Module

Isolate total RNA was isolated from tissue (∼1.5 mm 3 sections) using the RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, Catalogue #74104) according to manufacturer's instructions. On-column DNase treatment was performed using the RNase-Free DNase Set (Qiagen, #79254).
Select poly(A) mRNA using the NEBNext High Input Poly(A) mRNA Isolation Module (NEB, Catalogue #E3370S) as follows:

Isolate total RNA was isolated from tissue (∼1.5 mm 3 sections) using the RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, Catalogue #74104) according to manufacturer's instructions. On-column DNase treatment was performed using the RNase-Free DNase Set (Qiagen, #79254).

steps.title: Quantify and Quality Control RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using QUBIT and assess RIN values via Bioanalyzer (e.g., Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity kit (Agilent)).

substeps.instruction: Ensure at least 1.5 μg of RNA is available for subsequent steps

steps.title: Wash Oligo d(T) Beads
steps.instruction: Wash 20 μl of High Input Oligo d(T) 25 Beads twice with 100 μl of RNA Binging Buffer (2X) using a magnetic rack to pellet the beads.

steps.title: Prepare Beads for RNA Binding
steps.instruction: After the second wash, add 50 μl of RNA Binging Buffer (2X) and resuspend the beads by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Combine the washed beads in 50 μl of RNA Binging Buffer (2X) with 50 μl of RNA from the extraction step.

substeps.instruction: If total RNA volume is <50 μl, add nuclease-free water to reach a final volume of 50 μl

steps.title: Incubate RNA and Beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on a thermal cycler at 65 °C for 5 minutes, then cool down to 4 °C (with heated lid set to ≥ 75 °C).

steps.title: Resuspend and Incubate at Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads slowly but thoroughly and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads once halfway through the incubation

steps.title: Isolate poly(A)-selected RNA
steps.instruction: Pellet the sample on a magnetic rack until the supernatant is clear and colourless, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Perform First Wash Cycle
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with 200 μl of Wash Buffer by mixing thoroughly, pellet the beads, and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this wash process once more

steps.title: Release mRNA for Second Selection
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of Tris Buffer by gently pipetting and incubate on a thermocycler at 80 °C for 2 minutes, then cool to 25 °C (with heated lid at ≥ 90 °C).

steps.title: Re-bind RNA for Specificity
steps.instruction: Add an additional 50 μl of RNA Binging Buffer (2X) to re-bind the poly(A) RNA to beads and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads once halfway through the incubation

steps.title: Final Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Pellet the beads on the magnetic rack and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with 200 μl of Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add buffer and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature
Pellet the beads and remove the supernatant

steps.title: Elute Selected mRNA
steps.instruction: Release the selected mRNA from the beads by adding 17 μl of Tris Buffer, pipetting thoroughly, and incubating for 2 minutes at 80 °C, then cooling to 25 °C.

steps.title: Collect mRNA Supernatant
steps.instruction: Pellet the beads on the magnetic rack and collect the supernatant (poly(A)-selected mRNA) into a clean 0.2 PCR tube.

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Library
steps.instruction: Prepare the library for long-read direct RNA sequencing using the SQK-RNA004 ligation kit, following the latest manufacturer's protocol from the Oxford Nanopore Technologies website.

steps.title: Prime the Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Insert the RNA flowcell (FLO-PRO004RA) into the sequencer (e.g., PromethION 2 Solo) and prime it using 1 ml of priming mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare priming mix using 1170 μl of Flow Cell Flush [FCF] and 30 μl of RNA Flush Tether [RFT]

steps.title: Load Library and Sequence
steps.instruction: Combine 32 μl of the long-read direct RNA sequencing library with 100 μl of Sequencing Buffer (SB) and 68 μl of Library Solution (LIS), then load the total 200 μl on the flow cell.

steps.title: Basecall Data
steps.instruction: Basecall data using dorado (version 0.7.1-CUDA-11.7.0) with model rna004_130bps_sup@v3.0.1.

steps.title: Map Reads
steps.instruction: Map reads using minumap2 (-ax splice -uf -k14 -y) using the latest human reference genome (e.g., hg38).

steps.title: Visualize Data
steps.instruction: Visualize the data on IgV (version 2.18.2) using the sorted and indexed bam file (e.g., created with samtools 1.16.1).
